title: On the robustness of pullback attractors for a nonlocal reaction-diffusion equation under perturbation
summary: A parametric family of reaction-diffusion equations with nonlocal viscosity is considered. Existence of solutions and actually of pullback attractors is known from previous works. In this paper we obtain a robustness result of the attractors toward the corresponding minimal pullback attractor of the limiting problem. This result extends the ones obtained in \cite{5}. Actually here all terms (reactions, external forces and nonlocal viscosity functions) may vary with the parameter.
